title: Advancing Cryo-Electron Tomography with Tilt-corrected Bright-field STEM (tcBF-STEM)
content: 4D scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) phase contrast imaging has advanced rapidly with both instrumental and computational developments. Alongside progress in materials science, 4D-STEM phase contrast techniques such as ptychography and integrated differential phase contrast (iDPC) have been successfully demonstrated in biological systems using cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) [1,2]. Moreover, automation has been implemented and optimized for 4D-STEM techniques, including center of mass (COM) and iDPC, for cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) [3].
